adjudication.rationale: The diff shows `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` simply re-renders the current `@embedding` OpenStruct without persisting or changing anything (app/controllers/admin/embedding_controller.rb: update just calls `render_serialized`). The Ember controller defines `saveChanges()` that calls `this.get('embedding').update({});`, which would hit PUT `/admin/customize/embedding` via the new adapter and get a successful response even though nothing is saved. This is a real, diff-grounded incompleteness/confusion issue (a no-op “save” endpoint), but it’s not clearly a broken behavior in the current UI since host changes are saved through `embeddable-host` records instead.
